item.title: Olly Arkins to Exit Australian Festival Association
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music news update. We're coming to you from Australia, where a major change is happening in the festival scene. Olly Arkins, the CEO of the Australian Festival Association, is stepping down from her role after five years. Let's take a look at her legacy."
[Music transitions to a softer tone]
Host: "Under Olly's leadership, the AFA has worked tirelessly to promote festivals as a vital part of Australia's cultural infrastructure. She's helped secure significant reforms, including the rewriting of the Music Festivals Act in New South Wales, and advocated for funding and support for music festivals."
[Short sound clip of a music festival ambiance]
Host: "Some of her notable achievements include introducing drug-checking services at music festivals in Victoria and New South Wales, renegotiating the OneMusic licence scheme, and increasing funding for the Revive Live program. AFA chair Adelle Robinson praises Olly's relentless commitment to the industry, saying she's left a lasting impact."
[Music transitions back to the intro tone]
Host: "Olly's last day with the AFA is August 21st. She's credited with taking the festival industry from a uncertain time during the pandemic to a thriving and sustainable sector. We wish her all the best in her future endeavors. That's all for this week's update. Thanks for tuning in!"
[Outro music plays]
